hostPreflightDigest.source: "sha256:" and the sha256 of the enrolled native-qualification/v4 record's canonical bytes (the value of configuration v2's qualificationRecord.sha256)
gates: at every answer, the capture gate over every role, the lifecycle and every backend component of the record

sets.scheduledMonotonicMs: integer 0..2^53-1: the set's own scheduled start on the monotonic clock, recorded with the set
sets.startedWallMs: integer 0..2^53-1: the wall clock at the set's start (set_started_ms)

answer.monotonicMs: integer 0..2^53-1: the answer's reading of the monotonic clock of the scheduled starts
answer.wallMs: integer 0..2^53-1: a millisecond reading of the same wall clock as set_started_ms, handed to the I01 service with the view

hostPreflightDigest: backend/<every backendComponents key of the record>

rule: the latest completed set is the last entry of sets whose completed is true; none: the value's own text
every required slot of that set is TAKEN, else the value's own text
monotonic age = answer.monotonicMs - scheduledMonotonicMs and wall age = answer.wallMs - startedWallMs are both within 0..90000 ms, else <key>: capture set too old
the start is the set's own, never the epoch's current cycle; an Expired view is a set whose slots are EXPIRED

R-ADM-LIST.cannotSee: Whether the static admission objects appear in API lists, and with what uid and content; whether the apiserver refuses an API object named with the .static.k8s.io suffix. A listed object with a rendered (kind, name) is admitted by the unknown-object rule and rests on this check.

R-PSA-CONFIG.cannotSee: PodSecurity's configured defaults and exemptions (usernames, runtimeClasses, namespaces) in the sealed admission configuration file (SC05, --admission-control-config-file)
R-PSA-CONFIG.check: T04: the running PodSecurity configuration equals the enrolled file's, the record's APISERVER backendFiles row for the SC05 file

R-NET-DATAPATH.cannotSee: The live network datapath, including pod-IP behaviour for an ipBlock that overlaps the pod or Service ranges, and the running agent's flags against the sealed --fail-open=false and --disable-nri
R-NET-DATAPATH.check: T04 (owner): the agent's programmed nftables ruleset enforces the namespace's NetworkPolicy; the flags are the sealed ones

R-NET-AGENT.cannotSee: The network agent's executableLabel, artifactDigest and apiIdentities, which its backend capture does not compare, and its running image (ENTRY_BOUND: domain entry plus the measured file, not the running image). Custody link: check_record requires artifactDigest to equal the sha256 of the executable's backendFiles row (R10:obs/record_check.rs:915, :592-594), and each set compares the live file's contentDigest and verity with that row (R10:obs/capture_check.rs:630-634), so the artifactDigest check concerns only the running image.
R-NET-AGENT.check: T04-LABELS for executableLabel; T04: the running agent's executable content equals the record's artifactDigest; T04: the running agent's apiserver identities equal the record's apiIdentities; T04-ENTRYPOINT, T04-ENTRYPOINT-CENSUS and the matrix successor's execute_no_trans closure for the running image

R-DEFAULTS.cannotSee: Server defaulting of the real kinds' spec
R-DEFAULTS.check: T04, per kind (ResourceQuota, LimitRange, ServiceAccount, NetworkPolicy): the spec HE-008 captured at enrollment equals the spec served after an apiserver restart on v1.37.1

R-RBAC-COMPLETE.cannotSee: Completeness by refusal, not expansion (aggregations, impersonation paths, indirect grants); the system:authenticated limit

R-BROKER-LIVE.cannotSee: The BROKER document members its capture does not observe: the process image (LABEL_BOUND: bound by processLabel and the enrolled file's measurement); executableLabel (DECLARED_T04); seccompFilterDigest and seccompDefaultAction (DECLARED_T04, corroborated by the OBSERVED filter count); the cgroup's selinuxLabel (DECLARED_T04); listenEndpointIds and outboundEndpointIds (no class row; not compared by check_capture)
R-BROKER-LIVE.check: T04-SECCOMP-INSTALLED for the seccomp members; T04-LABELS for executableLabel and the cgroup's selinuxLabel; T04-ENTRYPOINT and T04-ENTRYPOINT-CENSUS for the image's binding; HE-005 and T04 for the endpoints: the broker's bound and connected endpoints equal the record's listenEndpointIds and outboundEndpointIds, resolved through the record's endpointTuples; HE-005 for the broker's behaviour

scopeLimits: one NetworkPolicy in the qualification namespace (v1); several take a List form for networkPolicy alone, through a contract revision
direct RBAC grants only: an aggregated ClusterRole that reaches the namespace refuses
